name: dotUSD
oneLiner: dotUSD is Polkadot's OpenGov-governed dollar stablecoin, initially minted 1:1 against USDT through a capped peg stability module on Asset Hub.
collateral: USDT in the initial peg stability module; DOT-collateral vaults are planned for a later phase.
pegMechanism: Capped 1:1 minting and redemption against USDT through an on-chain peg stability module; a treasury-seeded DOT/dotUSD pool supports swaps on Asset Hub.

milestones.title: dotUSD launches on Asset Hub
milestones.description: Referendum 1944 took effect, enabling the USDT peg stability module and a treasury-seeded DOT/dotUSD pool. DOT-collateral vaults remain a later phase.
